name: Missouri Adams (Hall)
notable_stories: Though born as Matilda, she adopted the name Missouri as a child and used it for the remainder of her life
milestones: Married David R. Hall (m. 10 Apr 1873, Chariton County, MO)
Migrated with the Adams family to Colorado in 1878
Buried at Fairmount Cemetery in Denver
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
Further Research on the Family and Descendants of Joseph P. and Elizabeth (Hamilton) Adams, William W. Allen (February 2012)
notes: Siblings listed: John Wesley, Col. Alexander William, Mary, Joseph Pierre Jose, Harriet E., James Casper, Virginia M., Nancy E.
Listed as Matilda in 1850; by 1860 known as Missouri, a name she kept for the rest of her life. [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 6608]
